text: 中国华君(0377.HK)在港公告，公司注意到今天公司股份价格的异常波动。经在当前情况下合理的所有查询后，董事会确认并不知悉任何导致股价波动的原因，也没有任何必须公告以避免公司股票市场出现虚假行情的信息，或需要根据《证券及期货条例》第XIVA部披露的内幕消息。董事会谨此知会，本公司现正与某方就一项潜在出售事项进行初步讨论。于本公告日期，磋商仍在进行中。
text_en: China Huajun (0377.HK) announced in Hong Kong that the company noticed abnormal fluctuations in its share price today. After all inquiries reasonable under the current circumstances, the board confirmed that it is not aware of any reason causing the share price fluctuation, nor any information that must be announced to avoid a false market in the company's shares, or inside information that needs to be disclosed under Part XIVA of the Securities and Futures Ordinance. The board hereby informs that the company is currently in preliminary discussions with a certain party regarding a potential disposal matter. As of the date of this announcement, negotiations are still ongoing.
